ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
vrtx is a command line tool for talking to several large language model
providers through a single interface built on LangChain. Google Gemini
support is installed by default, and the OpenAI and Anthropic providers
can be enabled by installing langchain-openai or langchain-anthropic
alongside this package.

It keeps conversation history between invocations, lets you register and
switch between configured models, and can read recent shell history to
explain commands that failed.
about.summary: A unified CLI tool for interacting with multiple LLMs via LangChain

name: vrtx
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.1.1"

package:
  name: vrtx
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/v/vrtx/vrtx-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f917259cee6414420a62664233a750a92613b9b9628061b9f50b2aad064b2fe6

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - vrtx = vrtx.prompt:main
      - vrtx-init = vrtx.utils:install_requirements

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=42
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - rich >=14.0.0,<16.0.0
    - langchain-core >=1.0.0,<2.0.0
    - langchain-google-genai >=3.0.0,<5.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - vrtx
        - vrtx.models
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - vrtx
      - vrtx list

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/prathamhole14/vrtx
  summary: A unified CLI tool for interacting with multiple LLMs via LangChain
  description: |
    vrtx is a command line tool for talking to several large language model
    providers through a single interface built on LangChain. Google Gemini
    support is installed by default, and the OpenAI and Anthropic providers
    can be enabled by installing langchain-openai or langchain-anthropic
    alongside this package.

    It keeps conversation history between invocations, lets you register and
    switch between configured models, and can read recent shell history to
    explain commands that failed.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/prathamhole14/vrtx
  documentation: https://prathamhole14.github.io/vrtx/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - prathamhole14
